//: Every `ser` operation on a shared cm/ is `-i Project.<SITE_COLLECTION_NAME>` — no unscoped op, ever (rule 84-sitecore-multisite-scoping).
//completeness: The site include has NO `*: Ignored` rule and defaults to ItemAndDescendants, so a subtree an author adds later is serialized by default rather than silently dropped. The older shape of this template listed six subtrees and ignored everything else, and additionally pinned /home to SingleItem — a brand seeded from it serialized the home ITEM and none of its pages. Add a rule below only to change the push policy for a subtree, never to opt a subtree in.
//push-policy: Dev items (settings/templates/branches/renderings/placeholder settings/Presentation) are CreateUpdateAndDelete so removals propagate to a target instance. Content and media are CreateAndUpdate — a push must never delete an authored page, datasource or image. Environment-coupled items (Site Grouping hostnames) are CreateOnly: they land once on a fresh target and are never overwritten afterwards.
//no-rendering-host: A Rendering Host item is NEVER included. Its fields are absolute editing-host URLs for one tenant, so serializing one puts environment state in git. CreateOnly does not mitigate it — on a fresh instance it still CREATES the item with the dead URLs and then refuses to correct it (observed 2026-08-13: a new tenant inherited a foreign org's -eh host). The binding is set per environment by /provision-sitecoreai § 7d, which writes the site-grouping RenderingHost field — a plain host NAME, needing no serialized item.
//no-auto-thumbnails: The platform writes a new media item for every page and site thumbnail it auto-captures, under <SITE_NAME>/System/<h>/<h>/<h>/<h>/. With the media include at ItemAndDescendants every pull committed them as base64 blobs (632 files, ~14 MB across six brands, removed 2026-09-28). The /System rule caps that folder at ItemAndChildren: the custom dashboard card System/thumbnail_<siteId> (set by /publish step 6c) stays serialized, and the auto-captures do not.
